_comment: Copy to host.auto.tfvars.json (gitignored) and fill for YOUR Proxmox host. These are the only host-specific values; everything else is spec-derived in terraform.tfvars.json and identical on any host. Also export PROXMOX_VE_ENDPOINT / PROXMOX_VE_API_TOKEN (and PROXMOX_VE_INSECURE=true for self-signed certs) before running terraform.
_cloud_from_remote: If Proxmox is cloud-hosted and you deploy from a REMOTE host: export PF_BASTION_ENDPOINT=<proxmox-public-ip> and PF_BASTION_SSH_PORT=<dnat-ssh-port> before deploy.sh (reaches the bastion via the host's public IP + DNAT); and add an ssh{node{name,address=<public-ip>}} block to versions.tf's provider so bpg's snippet SSH targets the public IP (the node reports its internal IP). See PROXMOX-DEPLOY-RUNBOOK.md.
